content:
q24.

The complete chain, one hop per line:

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts          — useCreateMemo mutation hook (line 178) calls memoServiceClient.createMemo (line 183)
web/src/connect.ts                        — memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport) (line 197)
proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go — generated Connect RPC: MemoServiceHandler.CreateMemo (line 409)
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go      — APIV1Service.CreateMemo handler (line 70)
store/memo.go                             — store.Store.CreateMemo (line 109), dispatches to the Driver interface (store/driver.go:29)
store/db/sqlite/memo.go                   — sqlite.DB.CreateMemo executes the SQL INSERT (line 16)
```

Notes:
- The server-side leg (handler → store → driver) is a resolved call chain confirmed by the code graph: `v1.APIV1Service.CreateMemo` → `store.Store.CreateMemo` → `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo`.
- SQLite is one of three interchangeable dialect drivers behind `store.Driver.CreateMemo` (store/driver.go:29); the equivalents are `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`.
- There's also a thin Connect adapter `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:306) that bridges the generated handler to `APIV1Service.CreateMemo`.
